subject: Request: 7-day pilot extension while procurement completes
messages:
From: Samantha Liu <samantha.liu@novanova.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2027 14:23:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot window concern / procurement delay

Hi Aditya,

Quick note from procurement: our vendor onboarding for Redwood is still waiting on a final vendor questionnaire and a PO approval from our finance committee. We were hoping to start the sandbox pilot this week, but it looks like sign-off will slip into next week.

We really like what we saw in the demo — especially the latency improvements on the NLU routes — and the product team wants to keep experimenting, but the pilot will expire if we don't extend it. Is there any flexibility to keep our sandbox active for another 7 days while procurement completes the paperwork?

If helpful I can loop in procurement@novanova.com and attach the redlined onboarding form they're asking about.

Thanks,
Samantha Liu
Product Manager, NovaNova Health
S: +1 (415) 555-0173

Thanks for the heads up, Samantha — and glad the demo landed well. I appreciate you flagging the procurement timing early.

Short answer: yes, we can extend the pilot for a short period. I need to run this by Ben (sales ops) for a quick sign-off on a 7-day extension and note the terms we attach (small token cap so we don't run into unplanned overage). Camila — can you confirm we have a 7-day voucher we can apply to NovaNova without opening the contract? If procurement needs a written confirmation of what will be available during the extended window, I can provide a one-page amendment.

Samantha — if procurement can send the onboarding questions and approximate PO date, I will include that in the amendment. I can also attach a light runbook for the pilot so your engineers can keep momentum.

Cheers,

Okay to proceed. Approve a 7-day extension with the following guardrails:
- One-time 7-day voucher, cap at $1,200 equivalent usage (covers typical pilot activity).
- No changes to SLA or support coverage.
- Require procurement to confirm expected PO date and that a PO is in flight (email from procurement@novanova.com) before extension is activated.

- Extension length: 7 days (starts immediately upon your confirmation)
- Usage cap: $1,200 equivalent (we'll notify you if usage reaches 80%)
- Condition: procurement sends a confirmation email that a PO is in flight before the voucher is applied (procurement@novanova.com copied here).

Attached: one-page amendment and a short pilot runbook we discussed.
